notes.title: Dragon Song Tavern: Cozy & Adventurous (PC) Review
notes.notes:
When an email for Dragon Song Tavern: Cozy & Adventurous landed in my inbox, the first thing I did was send it to CGM’s Dayna Eileen with the subject line: “Look how cute!” My love of sim games is pretty well known, and I’m always excited to play a game where restaurant management is involved, so this seemed like a slam dunk. But as I’ve often said, when delving into the Indie scene, you can find gems, or you can find stones.

Dragon Song Tavern: Cozy & Adventurous initially looked to me like a little more of what I wanted out of Cuisineer’s restaurant management, but the longer I played it, the faster I wanted to stop. It’s a game with a fair number of good ideas, but it is constantly marred by poor execution and a genuine lack of polish.

[p][b]Dear Adventurers,[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Since the release of our free demo on Steam, many players have taken the time to try it out. Your support and feedback mean a lot to us, and we'd like to express our heartfelt thanks to everyone who has played![/p][p][/p][p]As Dragon Song Tavern: Cozy & Adventurous is set to officially launch this September, bringing you new content including online co-op and other exciting features, we've decided to delist the current free demo for an upgrade temporarily. When the full version goes live, we’ll make sure every player can enjoy an even better experience.[/p][p][/p][p]Whether it's the demo or the full release, our goal has always been to bring you a joyful and memorable adventure. We'll continue working hard to deliver even richer and more enjoyable content when the full version launches![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you very much for your support!
[/p][p][b]The Dragon Song Tavern: Cozy & Adventurous Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: "Dragon Song Tavern: Cozy & Adventurous" First Test is Live! 🎮
notes.notes:
Dear Adventurers,
We are beyond excited to announce that the first public test of "Dragon Song Tavern: Cozy & Adventurous" will be available on Steam starting January 25th!
This is our first-ever open test, and we can’t wait to explore this magical world with all of you—a world that we’ve poured so much love and passion into! ✨

[h2]About Us: A Small Team, Big Dreams 💡[/h2]
We’re a small team of former colleagues, each with years of experience in the gaming industry, and we started this studio in April 2024 with nothing but love and dreams.
No external funding, no big team collaborations—just pure dedication to games and our commitment to players. Every day as independent developers is a challenge, but thanks to your support, we’ve come this far.
[b]Dragon Song Tavern: Cozy & Adventurous [/b]is the first game we’ve poured our hearts into since starting our studio. We are truly honored to share this with you.

[h2]About the Game 🏡[/h2]
[b]Dragon Song Tavern: Cozy & Adventurous[/b]is an indie RPG that combines cozy farming elements with exciting fantasy adventures. In this handcrafted fantasy world, you’ll take on the role of a tavern keeper, navigating between the everyday and the adventurous:
[list]
[*] Tavern Management: Plant, gather, cook, and serve adventurers;
[*] Adventure & Exploration: Embark on a journey, battle monsters, and find rare resources;
[*] Customization: Decorate your tavern, dress up your character, and show off your style;
[*] Character Interaction: Meet colorful characters and explore their stories.
[/list]
As an indie game, our goal is to offer players a unique experience that blends warmth and exploration.

[h2]About the Demo Test 🧪[/h2]
[h3]This demo includes 12 days of gameplay within the game’s timeline: [/h3]
This is our first public test, and we’ve chosen the early content of the game, covering up to Day 12 in the game’s time.[b] More content is in the works[/b], and we look forward to collecting your feedback to help strengthen the foundation for future development.

[b]⚠️ Content Not Finalized:[/b]
[list]
[*] Some features may still need optimization, such as the Workshop area’s interior and crafting presentation;
[*] The shop interior is currently a temporary design;
[*] Sound effects are still being added;
[*] The storyline is in its basic framework stage, so it doesn’t yet have full presentation effects;
[*] Other details: Some assets and animations may need further polishing in this test version.
[/list]
We truly hope you’ll approach this with an understanding attitude and provide us with constructive feedback. Your input is incredibly important to us!

[h2]Why Choose Indie Games? 💪[/h2]
Indie games are creations built with heart—no assembly lines, no compromises, just endless imagination and passion. Here, your feedback directly influences the development of the game. We hope that through this test, you’ll experience the charm of indie games and become a part of the game’s growth.

[h2]Join the Adventure! 🌟[/h2]
Thank you for supporting [b]indie game developers[/b]! Every wish list, every piece of feedback, is an immense encouragement to us.
Join the test or add the game to your wish list to receive the latest updates! We look forward to seeing you at the tavern,

[h3]With love from a small but determined indie team[/h3]
